how: We read the website of every Boston wedding planner listed on Lazo (143 listings, 119 sites reachable) and set aside the ones that are not really in the wedding business: justices of the peace and officiants, a makeup artist, a backyard-rental package company, venues with in-house coordinators, and a Western Massachusetts planner well outside the metro. What is left is a shortlist of vendors who say clearly what they do, show their work, and tell you how they work. Verified Lazo vendors come first. Nobody paid to be here, and this is not a ranking: Lazo ranks only on reviews from couples who booked.
ask: Full planning, partial or day-of: what does each tier include in hours, meetings and vendor management?
Which Boston, North Shore or Newport venues have you run a wedding at this year, and what did their load-in and noise rules cost us?
Who is on site on the day, you or an associate, and what is the rain or snow plan if my date is outside summer?

picks.name: Brilliant Event Planning - Boston & New England
picks.blurb: Brilliant Event Planning is a small Boston team with more than twelve years of planning, specializing in luxury tent weddings and full weekends of events across New England, Newport and Cape Cod. It takes a limited number of events a year and pitches itself to intensely busy professionals.

picks.name: The Little Things
picks.blurb: Alexis Accomando has led The Little Things in Waltham through hundreds of luxury weddings since 2014, backed by a master's degree in project management. The studio offers only full-service design, planning and production, so it can dig into your story and protect your time.

picks.name: Handy & Dallaire Events
picks.blurb: Founded by David M. Handy in 2004 and later joined by his husband Donald, Handy & Dallaire Events has designed weddings, events and fundraisers in Boston for over a decade. The firm's work has appeared in Vogue, House Beautiful, Veranda and Boston Weddings.

picks.name: Lia Bancroft Events
picks.blurb: Lia Bancroft plans bespoke seaside wedding weekends from private Newport estates to Cape Cod yacht clubs, blending family traditions with coastal elegance. Based in Boston and rooted in Cape Cod, she brings over a decade in corporate finance and consulting to the logistics side.

picks.name: Contagious Events
picks.blurb: Contagious Events plans and designs personal weddings across Boston and New England for couples who refuse to copy and paste, and says it knows Boston rooms well enough to make them unrecognizable. Three clear service levels, with no jargon and, in its words, no 47-row comparison chart. Based in Norwood.

picks.name: Something Bleu Wedding & Event Planning
picks.blurb: Something Bleu was founded in 2013 in Dedham for career-minded couples who need support planning a wedding, by a planner with a business and marketing degree and Wedding Planner Institute certification in planning, design and styling. The process runs from venue selection through vendor team and event design, for Boston and Newport.

picks.name: Elegant Aura | Wedding Planner
picks.blurb: Liz Quill owns Elegant Aura in Quincy and comes from interior design, event planning and restaurant management, which the site says lets her engage all five senses. Three levels of planning service are laid out for Boston and New England weddings, with calm under pressure as the selling point.

picks.name: 33 Munroe Weddings, Events, and Florals
picks.blurb: Bryan Finocchio's 33 Munroe combines wedding planning with floral design, so logistics and flowers are built together, with full and partial planning for Boston, Cape Cod and New England. The studio describes itself as inclusive, celebrating love in all its forms, and also produces galas and fashion shows.

picks.name: Without A Hitch
picks.blurb: Without A Hitch is a day-of coordination service for the hands-on couple who planned it themselves and want someone else to execute the plan. The site walks through the process, from the introductory meeting on timeline and services to the venue walkthrough. Based in Peabody.

picks.name: Planned Perfectly
picks.blurb: Leslie Cregg-Hyder has planned weddings and events for over seventeen years at Planned Perfectly, a full-service agency that also handles corporate events. The site says services are tailored to a variety of wedding styles and budgets rather than one fixed package.

picks.name: Casey & Co. Events
picks.blurb: Casey & Co. Events does full-service planning and design for coastal New England weddings at Newport's iconic venues and private estates. Casey pairs an eye for design with a deep grasp of logistics from over a decade in the industry, and describes the approach as calm and organized. Based in Jamestown.

picks.name: Prasang Decorators and Events Planners
picks.blurb: Prasang in Chelmsford is an Indian wedding stage decoration and event planning service covering Boston, Rhode Island and Connecticut. The team makes garlands and jaimalas to the couple's choice of flowers and budget, keeps a large selection of centerpieces, and also decorates arangetrams and anniversaries.
